name: dejavu-memory
description: Long-term memory for ChatGPT and Codex backed by your own DejaVu server, with a visual memory graph.

interface.shortDescription: Memory tree with a visual graph
interface.longDescription: DejaVu Memory gives ChatGPT and Codex a hierarchical, versioned memory tree. Store decisions, preferences, and reusable judgments once, then recall them with keyword or semantic search. The workspace includes an interactive graph of the memory tree with hybrid search, a content inspector, and subtree expansion. Data stays on your own DejaVu server, reached through its MCP endpoint.
